runs.text: is a name bound to a place in memory.
creates that place with the given type. With an initial value, the value is stored at once; without one, the box stays empty until the first assignment.

blocks.title: Variables in a backpack

blocks.description: Three boxes in memory: libros and cuadernos, of type Integer, start empty; nombre, of type String, starts with "Leo". Then libros receives 3 and cuadernos receives 6, computed by reading libros.

caption.text: creates a box with a name and a type. Those without an initial value start empty.

points.text: creates one or more variables of a type.
The initial value is optional and only valid with one name.
Without an initial value, the variable starts empty, not at zero.
A name is not repeated in the same scope.
